description:
Watch Governor DeSantis's Covid-19 mRNA Vaccine Accountability Roundtable in Florida on December 13, 2022. With Professor Jay Bhattacharya, MD, Florida Surgeon General Joseph Ladapo, MD, Bret Weinstein and several other leading doctors, scientists, and vaccine injured advocates.Show more In this video you can watch the roundtable itself as well as the real-time Facebook comments as the discussion was happening.
To watch the official video of the roundtable without Facebook comments, please go to: https://rumble.com/v20bgby-governor-ron-desantis-hosts-roundtable-with-surgeon-general-dr.-ladapo.html
